Thanks Jake — great questions. Short answers up front: 1) Recommended MAP sprint window: 3 weeks (eval + security/ops sign-off) leading to a decision milestone; 2) Dedicated SOW cadence: 4–6 week provisioning runway (hardware lead times depend on region), we can parallelize security/compliance work while the pool is provisioned; 3) We received your redline and will review — expect comments by EOD tomorrow.

I've attached an annotated MAP with milestone owners and a neutral acceptance matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private across latency, data isolation, cost, and provisioning time. The key trade: hosted gets you fastest dev loop and lower near-term ops, dedicated gives predictable throughput and SLOs, private is recommended only if you require on-prem air-gapped operation or specific KMS controls.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- This week: Redwood to deliver a short canary plan for hosted (2-week run, sample traffic) and a Dedicated provisioning checklist.
- Next week: joint security questionnaire review and redline of the MAA.
- Decision milestone: 2027-05-27 (MAP decision call) — target to choose mode and sign LOI.

If procurement needs legal language to accept a staged approach (hosted canary -> dedicated cutover), we can provide a conditional clause and rollback guarantees.

Cheers,

Internal note — please see my proposed breakdown for the canary and Dedicated runway. Summary:
- Canary (hosted): 2 weeks at 10 req/s -> estimate ~ $3.6k (tokens + ephemeral compute); minimal infra changes, can use our hosted model variants with prefix caching. SLO during canary: 95th p50 < 300ms, p95 < 700ms.
- Dedicated: 4–6 week provisioning; recommend ordering early in us-west to keep latency under 200ms median.
- Private: additional 6–8 week on-prem prep + security review; offer only if CareBridge requires in-country on-prem.

Jake / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. We reviewed procurement notes and Karthik's cost/runbook. Proposed MAP update below (condensed):

MAP sprint (target decision 2027-05-27):
- Week 0 (now): Redwood sets up hosted canary plan, deliver test harness and sample traffic script.
- Week 1: Joint security questionnaire and remaining redline resolution.
- Week 2: Hosted canary runs (2 weeks total, overlap into week 3 if needed).
- Decision call 2027-05-27: pick mode (hosted -> extend /hosted->dedicated cutover / go private).

Conditional MAA clause: we will add a clause that allows CareBridge to run a hosted canary with explicit acceptance gates (latency, data handling). If accepted, Redwood will hold dedicated capacity in a soft-reserve for the proposed cutover window; the customer can elect to execute a Dedicated transition within 60 days with a defined provisioning SLA. The clause contains rollback steps and data segregation commitments.

Estimated canary cost: $3.6k (2-week baseline) — we will invoice as usage; if you convert to Dedicated within 60 days Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the canary compute cost to the first month of Dedicated capacity.

Please confirm you are OK with the conditional clause language and the decision cadence. If procurement wants, we can prepare the MAA with the clause highlighted for faster signature.

Thanks — looking forward to the decision call.
Mina Haddad
